rated_messages.input_message: Pause. Notice what triggered you to smoke in the past. Now take one deep breath and remind yourself that you do not need to smoke.
Pause. Notice what triggered you to smoke in the past. Now take one deep breath and remind yourself that you do not need to smoke.
You don’t need to get rid of or change your thoughts about smoking—just let them pass by like a cloud in the sky.
If you miss doing something with your hands, try turning a coin or pen over and over with your fingers.
A funny thing about people is that we tend to believe what we tell ourselves. So make sure that whatever else happens today, tell yourself "I can, and I will stick to not smoking!"
Don't test yourself needlessly. If this social situation gets uncomfortable then leave briefly if you can. It really helps and it's fine to do it more than once!
Some places trigger powerful cravings, that is to be expected. Stop and notice where in your body you feel those cravings and remind yourself that cravings typically pass in 1 to 3 minutes

Now is a good time for BREAKS B=stop and Brake R=Read how your body feels E=Expand and take deep breaths A=Allow everything to be as it is K=Know what's important to you S=take 1 Step in a direction important to you
Urges are like annoying ads. You might see them but you don't have to buy what they're selling.
You were often stressed in this location and this might trigger urges. What can you do to reduce your stress here? If you can avoid this place until things settle down, then do.

Imagine that your urge is a backseat passenger trying to distract you from reaching your destination. See if you can choose to keep driving instead of allowing your urges to distract you from where you want to go.
